decision.reason: Actual maintained conversion, explicit ko NLI training, MIT and known q8 artifact, supported DebertaV2 architecture/tokenizer in Transformers.js 4.3.1.
decision.memoryAssessment: q8 file alone 338341610 bytes (~322.67 MiB); tokenizer 16316225 bytes. At least model-byte residency plus sessions/tensors/tokenizer copies is required, so actual process memory is higher; no Apple memory measurement, cannot declare phone/iPad feasible or impossible from file size alone. Dispose embedding session before loading NLI.

experiment.input: 12-16 newly authored public anonymous Korean premise/hypothesis pairs with direct entailment, explicit negation, uncertainty, attributed/quoted claims and question-vs-assertion distinctions. Separate dev examples; never inspect hidden heldout fixtures.
experiment.output: All three logits/probabilities via AutoModelForSequenceClassification + AutoTokenizer(text_pair), explicit id2label. Do not use zero-shot binary confidence as proof.
experiment.bounds: One model download only after experiment chosen; verify bytes+SHA256; record cold load/inference latency, process memory, request log and dispose/reload. Keep each pair below max512 including specials; no candidate-threshold tuning against heldout.
experiment.stop: Abort on session initialization failure, memory termination, or inability to distinguish simple Korean positive/negative/uncertain statements. No app integration during feasibility probe.
experiment.remaining: Only if sanity passes, freeze independent criteria and evaluate unchanged hidden suite by a separate evaluator.

decision.reasoningLimit: NLI verifies supplied premise/hypothesis pairs. It neither generates question candidates nor repairs missing candidates by itself; 0% question recall cannot be assumed fixed. Author relation and exact evidence provenance remain metadata constraints.

zeroShotCaveat: Transformers.js 4.3.1 zero-shot pipeline normalizes entailment against contradiction (multi_label or one label), omitting neutral; otherwise normalizes entailment across labels. Neutral unsupported text may therefore get high relative score. Use all-three-class logits for verifier.
maintenanceCaveat: LastModified and official ecosystem ownership are observed facts; no guarantee of continuing maintenance or model quality.
